opening.title:
The world's most innovative startups
need serious AI infrastructure.

hero.title:
Every hour you spend building it
is an hour you're not shipping.
hero.title2: We built the AI infra so you don't have to.
hero.subtitle: Presenting
hero.description: the platform to create, test, run, scale, monitor and manage production-ready AI. We run the servers, so you can focus on building the product.

whatIsOpenflow.title:
Build an agent once.
Sell it to every client you serve.
whatIsOpenflow.description: Whether it is a WhatsApp number or a dedicated website, each customer gets its own isolated channel, its own guest history, its own knowledge base, its own billing, its own everything. You improve the agent once; every client gets the update.

foundation.title: The foundation: multi-tenancy is our default, not a feature you build.
foundation.intro: We keep your tenants fully isolated so you can sell your agents unlimited times at any business scale.

multiTenancy.title: One agent. A hundred isolated tenants.
multiTenancy.description: Sell your agent to one customer or a hundred. Each gets their own channels, their own data, their own bill. You build once. We isolate everything.

multiChannel.title: The channels your audience already uses.
multiChannel.description: Your agents answer on WhatsApp, web chat, Instagram, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams, and Google Chat. Each customer connects their own channels.

deployToYourWebsite.title: One line of code. Live on any site.
deployToYourWebsite.description: Paste a script tag — the agent is on your customer's homepage. Branded, versioned, no cookies. Finished at 4:00, live at 4:05.

expensesControlPerTenant.title: Know what every customer is costing you.
expensesControlPerTenant.description: Spend is metered per customer, per conversation, per model call. Your margin stops being a guess. Spending caps and alerts included.

observability.title: "Why did it say that?" Answered in seconds.
observability.description: Every run recorded — prompts, tool calls, cost, latency — searchable across customers. Your customer sends a screenshot; you send the trace.

conversationsDashboard.title: One inbox. Every customer, every channel.
conversationsDashboard.description: Read along live, take over when a moment needs a human, assign teammates, leave notes. Agents handle the volume; your people handle the moments.

evals.title: Test before your customers do
evals.description: Run every change against a battery of scenarios and score it before publishing. No update quietly makes things worse.

revenue.title: Ready for turning AI into revenue?
revenue.intro: Even with a great agent, when the chat ends without closing, you lost a lead. We solved it:

formIntegration.title: The conversation is the form
formIntegration.description: Agents collect structured data in the chat, validate it field by field, and store it cleanly. Export the submissions to your preferred format.

leadScoring.title: Every chat carries a 0–100 lead score
leadScoring.description: Forty overnight conversations on Monday morning. The agent already scored them all while chatting. Sales calls the hot three first.

bookingSystem.title: Universal booking system
bookingSystem.description: Agents check availability and confirm bookings inside the conversation, while intent is at its highest.

payments.title: Take payment in the chat
payments.description: The moment a customer says yes, the agent closes — natively or through Stripe, PayPal, and Square.

studio.title: Build an agent in minutes.
studio.intro: We already designed the tools that will make it powerful. Batteries included.

agentBuilder.title:
Create complex agents.
In a few minutes.
agentBuilder.description: Shared logic, customized per customer — set each one's personality, knowledge, and tools in a visual editor, no code.

workflowBuilder.title:
Consistent processes.
Because control matters.
workflowBuilder.description: Drag steps and decisions onto a canvas. Agents handle open conversation; workflows run your fixed processes — returns, onboarding, escalation.

agentOrchestration.title:
Break down complex tasks.
Manage an agentic team.
agentOrchestration.description: A front-desk agent hands hard tasks to specialists and takes the conversation back when they finish. No thousand-line prompt to babysit.

anyLlmProvider.title:
Swap the model.
Refactor? Not needed.
anyLlmProvider.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Meta — switch models per agent whenever a better one ships. A dropdown, not a refactor.

agentSkills.title:
Write skills once.
Use them many times.
agentSkills.description: Package know-how — refund policy, tone of voice, playbooks — as skills your agents use exactly when relevant.

versionControl.title:
Publish or roll-back.
It's just one click.
versionControl.description: Every published agent is a frozen, numbered version. Bad prompt at Friday 6pm? One click back, not one lost weekend.

toolbox.title: Make your agents ready for the world out there.
toolbox.intro: An agent that can't reach your systems is just a chatbot. Our platform allows your agents to connect to everything.

diagram.title: Everything your agents connect to, in one map.
diagram.description: Channels, databases, MCP servers, internal tools, and orchestration — all wired to OpenFlow at the center.

connectAnyMcp.title: If it speaks MCP, your agent speaks it
connectAnyMcp.description: OpenFlow speaks MCP natively. Any tool that exposes a connector becomes an agent capability, with credentials managed per customer.

outOfTheBoxMcps.title: GitHub to Stripe, one click away
outOfTheBoxMcps.description: Around thirty pre-configured integrations — GitHub, Notion, Slack, Stripe, HubSpot, Linear, Figma, Zapier and more — installed in one click.

webSearch.title: Answers from today's web
webSearch.description: Agents search the live web, read pages, and explore entire sites — no setup, no stale prices quoted to a customer.

httpRequests.title: Call any API, even yours
httpRequests.description: Internal tools, custom backends, niche software — if it has an endpoint, your agent reaches it.

externalSql.title: Ask the database directly
externalSql.description: Agents answer from each customer's own database — inventory, orders, account data — read-safe and isolated.

browserAutomation.title: For the software with no API
browserAutomation.description: Agents operate a real browser — navigate, click, fill, extract — even on the supplier portal last updated in 2009.

codeSandboxes.title: A safe place for agents to run code
codeSandboxes.description: Disposable, isolated environments where agents write and run code: crunch a spreadsheet, transform an export, verify the math.

knowledge.title: An agent with proper business knowledge is effective,
knowledge.intro: an agent that guesses is a liability. Upload your documents, we'll feed them to your agent.

multimodalRag.title: Documents — actually understood
multimodalRag.description: PDFs, Office files, web pages, images, CSVs parsed with full layout awareness. Tables, headings, and structure survive intact.

kvStores.title: Prose in documents. Facts in tables
kvStores.description: Price lists, catalogs, per-customer settings — structured records your agents read and update exactly, never approximately.

userMemory.title: Agents that remember people
userMemory.description: Agents remember each person across conversations — preferences, history, context — so no one has to explain themselves twice.

engine.title: Proactive, always-on agents.
engine.intro: This is not 2025 anymore, the best agents don't wait to be messaged. They execute.

longRunningAgents.title: Agents that work for hours
longRunningAgents.description: A runtime built for real work: agents pause for human input, survive restarts, and resume exactly where they left off.

scheduledExecution.title: Set the schedule. It fires. Every time.
scheduledExecution.description: Run agents every morning, every hour, or the first of the month — per customer, surviving deploys and outages.

webhookTriggers.title: Events wake your agents
webhookTriggers.description: A new signup, a paid invoice, a support ticket — your agent acts the moment it happens. Configure any trigger.

waysToUse.title: Build your way, pay for what you use.
waysToUse.intro: Whatever you build, you only pay if it runs. Fund your account, we notify you when your balance is running low.

noCodeLowCodeApi.title: Three doors. Same platform.
noCodeLowCodeApi.description: Build visually with no code. Call any published agent as an API. Extend through custom integrations. Start where your team is.

claudeCodeMcp.title: AI-operable, not just AI-powered
claudeCodeMcp.description: OpenFlow ships as an MCP. Build, test, and publish agents from Claude Code — your AI tooling operating your AI platform.

payAsYouGoPricing.title: Priced like a cloud. Readable like a receipt.
payAsYouGoPricing.description: No seats, no plans. Each feature has a price; you pay for what you use, itemized and metered per customer. Price your own product with confidence.
